Name: Penny's New Style - Ponytails
Author: Beard0saurus
Description:
I’ve always had a soft spot for Penny — she’s such a kind and thoughtful character. So, I wanted to give her a bit more visual variety while keeping her original style. Using her canonical summer ponytail from Seasonal Outfits as a base, I created this add-on to imagine what it might look like if it were her main style, with her hairstyle naturally changing as her hair grows.
Please note, this is not a stand-alone mod but an add-on for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits – Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod.

[b][size=4]Seasonal Changes[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Spring – The beginning of the year and the first warm month. Penny has short hair and visible freckles due to the sunny weather.
[*]Summer – Her hair grows into the ponytail. Freckles become slightly more pronounced under the bright summer sun.
[*]Fall – Penny’s hair reaches shoulder length. Freckles fade a bit due to less sunlight.
[*]Winter – Her hair is long enough to braid. Freckles are barely visible due to the cold and lack of sun.
[/list]
[b][size=4]Other small portrait fixes were also made[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Refined lower jawline
[*]Adjusted hair outline on the summer hairstyle
[*]Removed skin highlights
[*]Corrected bluish lips and teeth on open-mouth portraits
[*]Slightly refined the hairstyles in sprites for Flower Dance and Winter Star
[/list]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/gXVwnH8/image.png[/img][/center][size=4]
﻿[b]Canon-friendly[/b][/size]
This add-on is totally lore-accurate, as long as you consider Seasonal Outfits to be canon. Two hairstyles are reworks of Penny’s existing look, while the other two are logical extensions of those designs, introducing no drastic changes in color or style.

[b][size=4]Creation Issues & Legal Details[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]The Spring, Summer, and Fall portraits were created using the [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url]﻿ by Poltergeister & Jaz — many thanks to them. The Winter hairstyle was inspired by the Childhood Sweetheart Caroline mod by sorkrimp, but was completely redrawn.
[*]Spring and Summer sprites are based on her Seasonal Outfits summer sprites with minor adjustments.
[*]Fall – The front sprite is the original sprite with buns lowered to shoulder length. The back sprite is based on hairstyle #30 from the in-game character editor, and the side sprite on hairstyle #25 from the in-game character editor.
[*]Winter – The front sprite is based on hairstyle #37 from the in-game character editor. The side and back sprites combine hairstyle #18 from the in-game character editor and the original summer hairstyle. 
[/list]
